sourceScope.explanation: Current base and live split public metadata define3903/3904 and link3247..3250. The newer official main-skill announcement supersedes old hero text. implementationInferences.adopted: Repeat the complete current text flow: issuer selects a current Hand owner again, that participant selects one actual Hand card to show, then reveal one top card and compare only that round frozen shown features. A match permits the next whole repetition while fewer than three deck cards have been revealed. Finally gain only the revealed deck entities, never the shown Hand cards.
Use current native effective displayed card names, including current OL short names; do not use optional conversion possibilities. Freeze category/suit/rank/name length at actual reveal.

Select equal numbers of actual original Hand and privately viewed top3 entities (zero exchange allowed). Replace their exact selected top positions, preserving the unselected deck and top order; do not add a free arbitrary deck reorder.

Each actual Tianhou invocation first expires only that issuer previous independently issued grants, preserving permanent/same-name grants from all other sources. Mere issuer skill loss/death does not equal the next invocation. A later actual Tianhou after reacquisition still ends that same issuer previous grant.

Use living current HP, including ties, at actual leaf trigger execution. Adjacency means neighboring living seats, with duplicate neighbor removed for a two-player table. Freeze the affected neighboring participants for that one real Thunder damage event, then use genuine native LoseHp sequentially.

At final actual Use target qualification, require one final designated nonadjacent target and a different actual actor from the holder. Compare against the native frozen effective rank; absent native rank is not replaced by a printed first material. Native numeric rank0 remains numeric0; a genuinely null rank has no greater-than comparison.

Accepted own-frame obligations finish native paid movement/HP/judgment children after source loss; dead actors receive no new personal choices or card gains. No fake Draw/Ending or damage facts are introduced.
